title: Support Reply Context
description: Normalised evidence context used before drafting a customer-facing Zendesk or email support reply.

customer_name.description: Customer or requester name if known. Use null when unknown.

organisation_name.description: Customer organisation or account name if known. Use null when unknown.

source_limitations.description: Known limits such as missing Zendesk access, stale notes, or unverified pasted claims.

latest_customer_ask.description: The customer's latest live question, issue, complaint, or requested outcome.

last_support_reply.description: Summary of the most recent support reply, if known.

confirmed_facts.description: Facts directly supported by provided or connected evidence.

uncertain_facts.description: Claims or assumptions that are not confirmed enough to state as facts.

prior_promises.description: Any prior commitments made by support, account owners, product, engineering, or leadership.

reply_goal.description: What the reply should accomplish, such as acknowledge, answer, request evidence, explain limitation, or provide status update.

safe_next_step.description: The safest confirmed next step that can be stated to the customer.

should_escalate_before_reply.description: True when internal review or escalation should happen before a substantive customer-facing answer.
